preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 22 contains miscellaneous laws — lost property, the bird's nest, mixed seeds, sexual ethics. 4QDeutⁱ preserves vv. 3–12. 4QDeutᵏ² covers vv. 3–12. Coverage is moderate.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. Standard orthographic variation only.
preamble.scroll_condition: 4QDeutⁱ provides a continuous reading of vv. 3-12.
